create table if not exists public.source_sync_events (
  event_id text primary key,
  job_id text,
  source text not null check (source in ('sellpia','smartstore','ably','makeshop')),
  event_type text not null,
  status text not null,
  event_at timestamptz not null,
  duration_ms bigint not null default 0 check (duration_ms >= 0),
  processed_rows integer not null default 0 check (processed_rows >= 0),
  total_rows integer not null default 0 check (total_rows >= 0),
  output_rows integer not null default 0 check (output_rows >= 0),
  file_name text,
  part_no integer,
  total_parts integer,
  worker_state text,
  retry_count integer not null default 0 check (retry_count >= 0),
  message text,
  payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.source_sync_events enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.source_sync_events from anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update on table public.source_sync_events to service_role;

create index if not exists source_sync_events_source_event_at_idx
  on public.source_sync_events (source, event_at desc);
create index if not exists source_sync_events_job_id_idx
  on public.source_sync_events (job_id) where job_id is not null;

create or replace function public.sv3p_log_source_sync_event(p_secret text, p_event jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_event_id text := nullif(btrim(p_event->>'event_id'), '');
  v_source text := nullif(btrim(p_event->>'source'), '');
begin
  perform 1 from public.sheet_mapping_page(p_secret, 0, 1);

  if v_event_id is null then
    raise exception 'event_id is required';
  end if;
  if v_source is null or v_source not in ('sellpia','smartstore','ably','makeshop') then
    raise exception 'invalid source';
  end if;

  insert into public.source_sync_events (
    event_id, job_id, source, event_type, status, event_at, duration_ms,
    processed_rows, total_rows, output_rows, file_name, part_no, total_parts,
    worker_state, retry_count, message, payload
  ) values (
    v_event_id,
    nullif(p_event->>'job_id',''),
    v_source,
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'event_type',''), 'UNKNOWN'),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'status',''), 'UNKNOWN'),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'event_at','')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'duration_ms','')::bigint, 0),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'processed_rows','')::integer, 0),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'total_rows','')::integer, 0),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'output_rows','')::integer, 0),
    nullif(p_event->>'file_name',''),
    nullif(p_event->>'part_no','')::integer,
    nullif(p_event->>'total_parts','')::integer,
    nullif(p_event->>'worker_state',''),
    coalesce(nullif(p_event->>'retry_count','')::integer, 0),
    nullif(p_event->>'message',''),
    coalesce(p_event->'payload', '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict (event_id) do update set
    job_id = excluded.job_id,
    source = excluded.source,
    event_type = excluded.event_type,
    status = excluded.status,
    event_at = excluded.event_at,
    duration_ms = excluded.duration_ms,
    processed_rows = excluded.processed_rows,
    total_rows = excluded.total_rows,
    output_rows = excluded.output_rows,
    file_name = excluded.file_name,
    part_no = excluded.part_no,
    total_parts = excluded.total_parts,
    worker_state = excluded.worker_state,
    retry_count = excluded.retry_count,
    message = excluded.message,
    payload = excluded.payload;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'event_id', v_event_id);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.sv3p_log_source_sync_event(text, jsonb) from public;
grant execute on function public.sv3p_log_source_sync_event(text, jsonb) to anon, authenticated, service_role;
